title: Phase 2：證明 OEIS A231897、A215461、A215462 三條「a(n) 永遠不會是…」的猜想（一行證明）

A231897-never-minus-1.proof: (2^a-1)^2 = (2^(a-1)-1)*2^(a+1)+1 has binary weight a, so a(n) <= 2^n-1 exists for every n (Lean a231897_exists, core only; Python a <= 3000, first 25 terms recomputed).

A215462-never-0.proof: Classical (AIME 1984 #14): for 2n >= 40 use 9, 25 or 35 according to 2n mod 6; the other summand is an odd multiple of 3 that is >= 9 (Lean a215462_pos; two implementations agree n < 600, zeros n < 200000 are only n <= 19).

A215461-never-0.proof: For n >= 6 one of 2n-3, 2n-5, 2n-7 is an odd multiple of 3 that is >= 9, paired with the prime 3, 5 or 7 (Lean a215461_pos; zeros n < 200000 are only n = 0, 1, 5).

novelty.note: All three proofs are exercise level; A215462 is a classical competition problem. Nothing new is claimed; the value is removing 'Conjecture' from three OEIS entries with a checked proof.
